query: SPC preliminary filtered tornado report counts for July 1 through July 9 in recent years (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025). I need the daily or summed number of filtered tornado local storm reports (LSR) from NOAA Storm Prediction Center daily storm reports pages (spc.noaa.gov/climo/reports) for the first 9 days of July each year. Provide per-year totals for July 1-9 if possible.
answer:
I've completed the research on SPC preliminary filtered tornado report counts for July 1-9 across 2021-2025.

## Key Findings

**Per-year totals (July 1-9):**

| Year | Total |
|------|-------|
| 2021 | 31 |
| 2022 | 22 |
| 2023 | 23 |
| **2024** | **113** |
| 2025 | 25 |

**The standout result:** 2024 is a massive outlier at 113 reports — nearly 4-5× any other year — driven almost entirely by **Hurricane Beryl**, which made Texas landfall on July 8, 2024. July 8 alone produced 66 filtered tornado reports (58% of the year's total) across Texas, Louisiana, and Arkansas.

The other four years cluster tightly in the **22-31** range, showing that a "normal" early-July window sees roughly two dozen filtered tornado reports over 9 days.

**Methodology notes:**
- Data pulled directly from SPC `filtered_torn` CSVs (spc.noaa.gov/climo/reports), counting data rows per day across all 45 daily files.
- These are preliminary/de-duplicated Local Storm Reports (F_Scale = "UNK"), not final NCEI survey-confirmed counts.
- A few residual "correction" duplicate rows persist; if further de-duplicated, effective counts drop slightly (~2021=30, 2022=18, 2023=22, 2024=112, 2025=24). Raw published row counts are reported as the primary figures.
- Full daily breakdown and per-day tables are in the detailed synthesis above.

sources.title: SPC Filtered Tornado Reports July 8, 2024 (Hurricane Beryl)

key_facts: 2024 is a dramatic outlier (113) driven by Hurricane Beryl, which made Texas landfall July 8, 2024 and spawned a tornado outbreak across TX/LA/AR.
July 8, 2024 alone had 66 filtered tornado reports, 58% of that year's 9-day total.
Excluding 2024, the four other years cluster tightly at 22-31 reports for July 1-9.
These are SPC 'filtered' LSRs (de-duplicated preliminary reports), not final NCEI survey-confirmed tornado counts.
All F_Scale values are 'UNK' in the filtered files; EF ratings appear only in later survey comment text.
Some correction/duplicate rows remain; de-duplicated effective counts would be roughly 2021=30, 2022=18, 2023=22, 2024=112, 2025=24.
Landspout tornadoes are included in the counts (common in CO/NE/WY).
SPC convective days run ~12z-12z UTC, so early-morning reports attach to the preceding day's file.
